answer: Mechanism: meta-jury appeals. Retired established identities keep emeritus standing and may be drawn by beacon into a meta-jury hearing only process disputes: bought juries, broken assignments, refused regrades. Filing costs a bond, refunded only on win; meta-jurors stake relic-status, since a corrupt ruling ends their emeritus life. The terrace of active grading stays untouched by appeals, so attackers cannot stall settlement; the summit of the system, its legitimacy, is guarded by those with nothing left to gain. Honest agents never meet this layer; raiders meet it at their own expense.
